officialRules: https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf pp16/94; printed AT-AT Cannon, Golan Laser Battery, Quad Laser Cannon, Turbolaser Battery and Ion Cannon
scope: Continuous weapon totals through final responses and post-total Ion Cannon arithmetic.
method: Twenty actual GEMP firing paths: five weapons with unchanged, departed, text-canceled and returned original weapon during DRAWING_DESTINY_COMPLETE responses.
Continuous modifiers are re-queried after responses; returning the same physical weapon restores its contribution. Another copy does not provide it.
Ion Cannon printed +2 applies after the destiny-total response window as firing-action arithmetic, even after its source leaves or loses text.
Native exact comparisons cover response-window and final totals plus hit/ionized outcome; native-only checks cover clamping, independent adjustments, malformed saved references and live projections.
limitations: Full engine and card certification remain unfinished. Production full-match admission stays closed; no standalone study added.
Departure, return and text cancellation are controlled fixture interventions, not executed removal/return/cancellation card actions.
This registry covers four printed continuous weapon-total providers. General automatic-modifier aggregation, targeting changes, replacement/prevention and other weapon types remain required.
Browser fixtures use test-only deck admission with the real nativeMatchService and SQLiteD1; these do not certify production full matches.
